detail.longDescription: When agent ships code faster and faster, human review is no longer possible. Which brings 2 problems, at least for me: 1. I need to understand what my agent changes as quickly and easily as possible, cuz I don't wanna lose track of the current status of my product, or be the main bottleneck in shipping code. 2. I don't trust what my agent tells me. Many times, I've been suffered from agent telling me "all is well", then say "you are right, sorry, I missed..." after code failed on production. To mitigate those problems, I made Genesis, a skill for coding agent to generate a beautiful flow chart to understand all the business flows, flag all risk changes and untested code between commits. It worked very well on me, so I benchmarked it against vanilla Claude code and Codex: Vanilla → With Genesis 1. Test gaps caught: Claude Code 8% → 38% · Codex 4% → 23% 2. False alarms per review: Claude Code 2.1 → 0.7 · Codex 1.4 → 0.5 3. Real risks found per review: Claude Code 2.9 → 2.8 · Codex 2.4 → 2.4
